info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Hotel Loyalty Points Redeem-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the redemption of hotel loyalty points, enabling customers to exchange their accrued points for various rewards or benefits. By utilizing this endpoint, users can initiate a redemption process seamlessly within their loyalty program. The API is primarily targeted at hotels, loyalty program administrators, and customer service applications that manage customer rewards. Typical use cases include processing point redemption requests and integrating loyalty services into hotel management systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to redeem their accumulated reward points in exchange for various rewards. Ensure you have sufficient points before making a request.

requestBody.description: The request body containing the necessary information to redeem points. Ensure that the payload adheres to the specified schema and includes all required attributes.
